title: GroundedPath
description: An ordered path whose relation steps have been evaluated under ONE profile, temporal coordinate, and admission policy. CRITICAL: a conforming path operation MUST generate candidate paths over the TIME-INDEXED PROJECTED graph. It MUST NOT traverse an all-time graph and merely filter citations afterward while claiming temporal-topology conformance. `admissible` is true only when every step is admitted by the policy; it does NOT mean every step is evidentially supported.

id.description: Opaque identifier for this path result.

steps.description: The ordered traversal steps. A grounded path is non-empty: this operation returns relational paths, so a query whose source and target entities are identical does NOT yield a zero-length path. Every step preserves its evidential state.

queryTime.description: The query time the projection was built for.

admissible.description: Whether every step was admitted by the admission policy at the query time. Admission is NOT evidential support: a recall-oriented policy may admit refuted or contested relations, so an admissible path may contain steps that are not supported. A path is positively supported only when every step's `evidentialState.state` is `supported`; consumers requiring positive support MUST check the steps rather than this flag.

rankingExplanation.description: Optional structured explanation of the score.

excludedStepIds.description: Identifiers of steps excluded from the admissible path.
